_readme: Past projects. Each entry = one job. Photos live in images/projects/<slug>/, floor plans / layout drawings (optional) in images/projects/<slug>/plans/. Entries with "sample": true are SAMPLE placeholders (illustrative plans and images, not real clients). Delete them once real jobs are added. See UPDATING.md.

projects.title: SAMPLE: Kosher Kitchen & Dining Re-Layout
projects.summary: A placeholder showing how a kitchen layout project will appear.
projects.description: SAMPLE ENTRY, not a real client. Images and the plan sketch are placeholders. A real project would explain the layout problem and the solution, for example how the kitchen was re-planned into separate meat and dairy work zones, each with its own sink and stove, plus a pareve island, and how the wall to the dining room moved so the table could extend for Yom Tov with a clear walkway behind the chairs.
